title: What are the rate limits for the API calls to Freshdesk?
snippet:
The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan. This limit is applied to your account irrespective of the number of agents you have or IP addresses used to make the calls.
We're currently moving all Freshdesk accounts from a per-hour limit to a per-minute limit. In this article, we'll give you details on both.
**Call limits per minute**
| ** Plan** | ** Calls per minute** | **Maximum limit per endpoint** |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 0 | 0 |
| Growth | 100 | Ticket Create - 50 Ticket Update - 50 Tickets List - 40 Contacts List - 40 |
| Pro | 400 | Ticket Create - 160 Ticket Update - 160 Tickets List - 100 Contacts List - 100 |
| Enterprise | 700 | Ticket Create - 280 Ticket Update - 280 Tickets List - 200 Contacts List - 200 |

title: How Does the Freshdesk API Work? Auth, Rate Limits and Endpoints (2026)
snippet:
The Freshdesk REST API (v2) authenticates with your API key as the Basic auth username and caps calls per minute by plan, from 100 on Growth to 700 on Enterprise. Most production problems come from that shared per-account limit, so knowing the headers and sub-caps saves an outage.

- Freshdesk API rate limits are per minute and per account: 100 calls on Growth, 400 on Pro, 700 on Enterprise, 50 on trials and none on Free.
- On the Freshdesk Growth plan, ticket create and ticket update are each capped at 50 calls a minute, and even invalid requests count towards the limit.

The Freshdesk API is a REST API (v2) at `https://{your-domain}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/`, authenticated with your API key as the HTTP Basic username and any string such as `X` as the password, and rate-limited per minute by plan: 100 calls on Growth, 400 on Pro, 700 on Enterprise and 50 on a trial. The Free plan gets no API access. The limit is shared by every integration on the account, and even invalid requests count against it.
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Base URL | `https://{your-domain}.freshdesk.com/api/v2/{resource}` |
| Auth | HTTP Basic: API key as username, `X` as password |
| Rate limit | Per minute, per account: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700, trial 50, Free 0 |
| Page size | 30 by default, 100 maximum with `per_page` |
| Search | 30 results a page, pages 1 to 10 (300 results) |
| Rate-limit error | `429` with a `Retry-After` header |

This is the part that breaks integrations in production. Freshdesk enforces a **per-minute** call limit (it moved from an older per-hour model), and the ceiling depends on your plan. Per Freshdesk's support article on [API rate limits](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/225439-what-are-the-rate-limits-for-the-api-calls-to-freshdesk-) (updated 6 August 2026) and the [developer reference](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/), checked 24 September 2026, the current figures are:
| Plan | Calls / minute | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 0 | No API access |
| Growth | 100 | Ticket create 50, ticket update 50, tickets list 40, contacts list 40 |
| Pro | 400 | Ticket create 160, ticket update 160, tickets list 100, contacts list 100 |
| Enterprise | 700 | Ticket create 280, ticket update 280, tickets list 200, contacts list 200 |
| Trial | 50 | Applies during any trial period |

title: API Limits for Sales and Support Products in Freshworks
snippet:
The following tables outline the API Access limit based on plans:
**Chats/Conversations**

| NA | NA | 2000 APIs/Min | 2000 APIs/Min | |

**Note**:
- The API limits mentioned in this article do not apply to Freshchat Classic, Freshcaller Classic, Freshsales Classic, and Freshmarketer Classic.
- If you want to increase the API limit for any of the modules, drop an email to [support@freshdesk.com](mailto:support@freshdesk.com)
- Certain limits exist to control the number of API requests sent from an account. Below are a few points to be noted regarding the limit:
- Limit: The limit is calculated as requests per min/hour per account.
- Indicator: If the limit is reached, your [response status code ](https://developers.freshchat.com/api/)reads 429 (Too many requests).
- This limit is on an account level for Chat/Conversations only. For other modules, it is at an agent level. It is irrespective of the number of users.
- This limit applies to all the activities performed through [API requests](https://developers.freshchat.com/api/).

title: How Do You Create a Ticket with the Freshdesk API? (2026)
snippet:
- Freshdesk's Growth plan allows 100 API calls a minute with 50 ticket creates, Pro allows 400 with 160, Enterprise 700 with 280, and the Free plan gets 0.

To create a ticket via the Freshdesk API, send one `POST` to `/api/v2/tickets` with your API key as the basic-auth username, a requester identifier such as `email`, and integer codes for `status` and `priority` (Open is `2`, Medium is `2`). A success returns HTTP 201 with the new ticket `id`. The API needs a paid plan or a trial: Freshdesk's Free plan gets 0 API calls a minute.

This is the honest constraint. Freshdesk enforces a **per-minute** rate limit that varies by plan, and — the part people miss — a separate **sub-limit specifically on ticket creation**. Per the [rate-limits article](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/225439-what-are-the-rate-limits-for-the-api-calls-to-freshdesk-) (updated 6 August 2026). Freshworks notes it is still moving accounts from per-hour to per-minute limits in batches, so check your response headers:
| Plan | Account limit / min | Ticket Create / min |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 0 | 0 (no API access) |
| Trial | 50 | Counts toward the 50 |
| Growth | 100 | 50 |
| Pro | 400 | 160 |
| Enterprise | 700 | 280 |

**What are the create-ticket rate limits?** Per-minute and plan-gated: 0 on Free, 50/min on trial, 100/min on Growth (50 creates), 400/min on Pro (160 creates), 700/min on Enterprise (280 creates). Exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header, and even failed requests count toward the quota.
